title: Middleware Channel Host Capability Call v1
description: Module-authored request body for invoking one host-authorized capability or reading its host-owned routing view through an authenticated channel session.

capability/id.description: Single host capability registry identifier; slash-separated peer wire names are not valid here.

operation.description: Invoke dispatches the capability. Lookup reads the same host-owned routing view as GET /v1/host/capabilities/{capability-id} and requires an empty request with immediate completion.

completion/mode.description: Requested host completion contract. Deferred is capability-specific and fails closed when the selected capability does not support it.
